title: Operator-guided Private Network Onboarding: installer flows, visual diff, and upgrade path screenshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a set of operator-centric visual assets and annotated screenshots for the Private/VPC onboarding flow. Deliverables include: a consolidated networking flow (IPv4/IPv6 and dual-stack notes), step-by-step installer screenshots (CLI + Console hybrid), upgrade modal and rollback visuals for in-place upgrades, visual diff overlays to show pre/post upgrade topology, and an accessibility-compliant checklist for operators. Assets will be used in the quickstart docs, in-product onboarding, and the admin runbook.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Finalized Figma frames for each installer step (desktop and tablet) with annotated copy
A2: Networking flow diagram exported in SVG and PNG with editable layers for infosec reviews
A3: Upgrade modal + rollback visuals with visual diff overlays and success/failure states
A4: All images compressed for docs and a separate high-res pack for the console team
A5: Accessibility contrast and text-size pass for on-screen steps; checklist included
A6: Hand-off package uploaded to Drive and linked in PR and Confluence page
design_notes: Focus on an operator-first mental model: clear network states (unprovisioned, provisioning, provisioned), error states tied to common infra issues (CIDR overlap, DNS unreachable, KMS not accessible), and an explicit rollback path. Use color-coded lanes for control-plane vs data-plane, and micro-annotations for firewall rules required. Keep copy short and prescriptive ("Run: redwood install --private --cidr X") and provide an inline 'Why this matters' microcopy for each step. Include both Console-first and CLI-first entry points and a quick tip card for air-gapped installs.
handoff_checklist: Upload final Figma file with versioned frames
Export SVGs and PNGs in required resolutions
Add alt text and short captions for each image
Link assets on the Docs PR and Confluence runbook
Create example CLI snippets for each installer step
Coordinate with ENG for integration into the onboarding modal
